summary: Steel M-M fire tower on Penn View Mountain, Indiana County, built 1935 with CCC labor and removed in 1981; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Steel M-M tower, about 80 feet (24.4 m)

events.note: Register date; early 1935 notices describe the tower being erected with CCC camp labor
New tower was to take the place of an older beacon light tower, with the beacon placed atop the new tower
Register says the tower was removed in 1981
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 16, 2008

evidence.supports: Steel M-M tower built 1935 and removed 1981
evidence.quote: This steel M-M tower was built in 1935 and removed in 1981.

evidence.supports: January 1935 notice: new tower replaces beacon light tower; beacon placed atop the new tower
evidence.quote: It will take the place of the beacon light tower and the beacon will be placed atop the fire tower, a distance of 80 feet.

evidence.supports: February 1935 notice: 80-foot tower; construction to continue with CCC camp labor
evidence.quote: Construction of an 80-foot fire tower at Penn View near Blairsville will be continued with CCC camp labor as soon as weather moderates.

evidence.supports: Foundations already poured at the site in February 1935
evidence.quote: Foundations have already been poured at the Penn View site.

notes_for_editor: Construction is well documented in 1935 notices quoted on the weebly page and in a 2000 Gazette feature on the CCC in Indiana County. The 1981 removal date rests on the register alone. Burrell Township and Penn View Mountain come from the 2000 article; the register gives only Indiana County. The brief's 24.4 m height is the 80-foot figure from the 1935 notices, not a measured height. The 1935 notices are read through the weebly page, not the original newspapers. No present-day or access information was found. The Feb 1935 erection detail comes from the 2000 article, which relays Clarence Stephenson's county history (quoted in the article), not from a first-hand report.
